summary: Retest after bugfix round (Cleanora). Backend: pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_media_logo.py 28/28 green against the public preview URL, incl. the previously CRITICAL brute-force lockout regression (now 429 instead of 500) plus a new test that the correct password is also 429 while locked. Frontend (Playwright, public URL): admin login OK, Medien tab placeholders render when no logo is set (no broken , no 404 for /api/media/logo), PNG upload updates logo-scale-preview immediately WITHOUT page reload (cache-buster ?v=updated_at, naturalWidth=400), slider live-scales the preview (40px -> 72px / 180%), JPEG replace refreshes the preview with a new stamp, delete switches both previews back to the placeholder and the navbar keeps the default CLEANORA wordmark. Desktop 1920: section padding now 112px (was 160px), hero headline->intro gap 40px, no horizontal overflow. Mobile 390: no overflow, menu X icon visible (white, 20x20), mobile nav navigation works. Zero JS console errors and zero >=400 responses across all flows. All 5 previously reported iteration_1 issues are verified fixed. Test data cleaned up: logo deleted (uploads dir empty, media state logo unset), TEST_lockout_probe entries removed from login_attempts.

minor.issue: allow_credentials=True combined with CORS_ORIGINS='*' is an invalid CORS combination (browsers reject credentialed wildcard). Currently harmless because auth uses a Bearer token, but should be an explicit origin list.

JWT is returned in the JSON body and stored in localStorage (frontend/src/lib/api.js) instead of an httpOnly cookie -> XSS-exfiltratable token. Playbook item 'httpOnly cookies on login' is not implemented (design decision, non-blocking).

Tests live under /app/backend/tests, which uvicorn --reload watches. Editing test files mid-session restarts the backend and caused 2 spurious media-lifecycle failures (upload 200 then GET 404). Recommend --reload-exclude tests/* or moving tests to /app/tests.

issues: MediaCard logo preview sits on the dark 'precision' background; a transparent/dark PNG logo is barely visible there (the LogoScale preview correctly uses a white backdrop). Cosmetic only.
Two non-Home sections (CTA/FAQ area, rendered from other components) still use 128px lg padding while Home.jsx sections are 112px - slight vertical rhythm inconsistency, cosmetic.

action_items: Optional: set explicit CORS_ORIGINS instead of '*' since allow_credentials=True
Optional: exclude tests/ from uvicorn reload watcher to avoid flaky local test runs
Optional cosmetic: white backdrop for the MediaCard logo preview
critical_code_review_comments: server.py login: locked_until tz-normalisation is correct now; consider storing timestamps consistently tz-aware to avoid the same class of bug elsewhere (contact_requests.created_at etc.).
Brute-force key is '{client_ip}:{email}'; behind the ingress the forwarded IP can rotate, so lockout can be diluted across keys. Consider an additional email-only counter.
seed_data_creation: Temporary logo uploads (PNG + JPEG) via admin UI - deleted afterwards; login_attempts probe entries TEST_lockout_probe / TEST_lockout_probe2 - purged by the new clean_login_attempts fixture (verified empty).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin tab testids are admin-tab-{requests|email|site|legal|media} (NOT German labels). Login needs a ~1s settle wait after page load before filling the form, otherwise the submit is swallowed. Added conftest fixture clean_login_attempts (pymongo, case-insensitive purge of test_lockout_probe keys) - required because server lowercases the email in the lockout key and a stale 15-min lock makes the brute-force test fail. Do not edit files under /app/backend while a test run is in progress (uvicorn reload).
rca_of_the_issue: Iteration_1 lockout 500 was caused by comparing a naive Mongo datetime with an aware now(); the fix normalises locked_until to UTC and is verified (429 for wrong AND correct password while locked). The first retest run of the lockout test failed only due to test isolation (leftover 15-min lock from the previous run) - fixed inside the test fixture, no product change. The two media-lifecycle failures in that same run were caused by the backend hot-reloading when I edited files inside /app/backend; both passed on a clean run.
